text:
maria: Quick follow-up from yesterday's outage. We keep seeing repeated-stop prompts causing token growth and memory pressure. Need concrete follow-ups with owners and dates.
kevin: Agreed. Proposal: small prompt regression suite, targeted load test simulating KV warm/cold transitions, and a chaos drill for OOM fallback timing.
jess: I'll own the regression suite. Plan: 12 prompt cases, 5 seeds each, compare token-growth slope vs baseline, flag >2x. Will PR to evals. ETA Friday COB.
maria: Ensure the harness can run against both hosted and dedicated endpoints. Example:
python evals/run_prompts.py --targets=hosted,dedicated --cases=prompts/incidents/*.json --seeds=5
jess: Done. I'll add a `failure_reason` label when divergence detected and include sample outputs.
rohan: I'll take load tests. Extend k6 scenario: ramp to 500 RPS over 10s, include sequences that exercise KV cold starts and evictions. Target: 95th <= 300ms. ETA next Wed.
kevin: I'll run the chaos drill. Simulate GPU OOM and assert fallback to low-memory variant within 10s and emit telemetry events `fallback.triggered` and `fallback.duration_ms`. ETA 2 weeks.
maria: Who wires alerts? We want CI/Grafana alerting for regressions and paging on P0.
jess: I'll add a metric `prompt_regression_rate{case="repeat-stop"}` and a panel. Page if >5% failure over two consecutive runs.
maria: Paging flow: eng-ml oncall P0, escalate to eng-sre after 15m.
kevin: I'll link PRs & tests to PM-432 and add a short verification checklist for post-run validation.
rohan: Reproducible only when prompts have repeated stop markers. Adding `prompts/incidents/repeat-stop.json` with minimal trigger.
ci-bot: New PR by jess: https://git.redwood/evals/pulls/140 (prompt-regress harness + cases)
maria: Recap: jess EOW; rohan next Wed; kevin 2w; jess to add alerts; everyone update PM-432 in 48h with PR links. Blockers?
rohan: Need a reserved GPU for isolated load runs. @infra-team please advise.
kevin: Need read access to fallback logs. @eng-sre can you grant `kevin` read to `logs/fallback/*`?
eng-sre-bot: Access request ACC-801 filed for kevin. ETA 1 business day.
maria: Scheduling a 30-min chaos drill next Fri 10:00am with oncall. Invite soon.
jess: :thumbsup:
kevin: lgtm
rohan: thanks all
